title: MeetOnTrack shared settings (~/.config/meeting-copilot/config.json)
description: One settings file for every component: the Swift Mac app (Config.swift), the Windows installer and C# recorder (AppSettingsStore, same path under the user profile) and the Python web server. Each component owns some top-level sections and writes only those, with read-modify-write that preserves every key it does not own. Writers serialize on the advisory lock file config.json.lock next to this file, write a 0600 temporary file in the same folder (mode set before any data), fsync it and replace atomically; config.json is always 0600. A file that exists but cannot be parsed blocks every save and is never treated as empty.

ai.description: Owner: Python web server (copilot/web/ai_providers.py), the only writer. The one AI choice the person makes in Getting started; every AI task uses it (owner decision 2026-10-21). Values are user choices read from the installed provider's own discovery; no component may hold or fill in a default model, effort or speed.

purposes.description: Superseded 2026-10-21 by choice. Read once: when choice is absent, the complete per-task choices are carried over (all identical, or only one: that one; several differ: live_analysis if complete, else none), and without any, the old summary.backend / speaker_names.backend by the same rule. Never read once choice exists; left in the file untouched.

recordings_dir.description: Owner: Swift Mac app / C# recorder.

transcription.description: Owner: Swift Mac app / C# recorder. Speech-to-text; the engine registry is phase 3.

live_transcription.description: Owner: Swift Mac app / C# recorder.

summary.description: Owner: Swift Mac app. Its old backend/model keys feed ai.choice once (see ai.purposes).

speaker_names.description: Owner: Swift Mac app. Its old backend/model keys feed ai.choice once (see ai.purposes).

auto_record.description: Owner: Swift Mac app / C# recorder. Also read by the Python web server.

interface_language.description: Owner: Swift Mac app. Also read by the Python web server.

task.description: The AI tasks, all run on ai.choice. Python runs the first four; Swift runs summary and speaker_names. A task the choice cannot do (frame_relevance needs a model discovery reports as accepting images; live_analysis with selected repositories needs Codex or Claude Code) is unavailable with its reason; no other task is affected and nothing falls back to another model.

choice.description: A choice runs only when all four keys are present; a missing ai.choice or a partial one (for example provider and model carried over once from the old summary settings) means not chosen: every task reports needs_choice and nothing runs.

provider.description: Adapter name, e.g. codex, claude, antigravity, ollama.

model.description: Model id exactly as the provider lists it.

effort.description: One of the effort levels the provider lists for the model; empty only when it lists none. A missing key means not chosen.

speed.description: "standard" (default tier, chosen explicitly) or a speed tier id the provider offers for the model and plan; empty only when no tier is offered. A missing key means not chosen.
